intent: Logo animation: the rolling pin rolls a half turn across the mark, compressing slightly at the handles, while the wheat sprigs fan outward and spring back into symmetry.
Logo animation: the pick drops into place with a tiny squash, then the three strings sweep across from left to right like strummed bands.
The stair blocks rise upward in sequence like an escalator, then the metro circle draws attention with a smooth scale pop and settles into a clean transit mark.
The cat rides the conveyor belt while tightening a wobbling bolt with quick ratchet clicks; the belt loops steadily and the loose gear beside it gives a satisfied spin.
The cat drummer snaps into a short drum fill: both sticks alternate downstrokes on the toms, the cymbal wobbles after each hit, and the tail flicks sharply on the final beat.
The frog crouches, blinks, then springs upward on stretchy legs to sniff the flower; the flower head nods from the tiny impact and rebounds.
The garden shears snap closed around the tall stems with a crisp overshoot; the cut flower heads pop upward slightly, then tumble down with a playful rotation.
Logo animation: the seesaw pivots around the center triangle while the soccer ball hops from the low end to the high end, landing with playful easing.

The small spacecraft marker coasts along the elliptical transfer path from the inner orbit toward the outer planet, easing fastest near the sun and slower near apoapsis; the two planets advance slightly on their circular guide orbits.
Logo animation: the compact car squashes slightly on its tires, then does a cheerful two-hop bounce with the wheels lagging and settling into place.
Logo animation: the round owl badge rotates in from -12 degrees, both eye discs bounce into place sequentially, and the beak flips down to a crisp stop.

The raccoon pops out of the sidewalk trash can, lifting the lid like a hinged hat and blinking at the street. The lid wobbles on its pivot while the raccoon’s paws grip the rim and its head bounces up into view.
The rope is pulled down on the free end, causing the lower pulley and attached load to rise at half the rope speed; arrows emphasize the mechanical advantage.
The street bridge deck rotates upward around the left trunnion while the counterweight descends, with the dashed arc showing the deck tip path and a small bounce at the raised stop.
The crank turns twice, then the lid snaps open and the clown puppet springs upward with a stretchy overshoot before settling into a wobble.
When the switch closes, current runs through the coil and the compass needle swings toward the electromagnet, overshooting slightly before damping back.
The duck sailor rocks with the rowboat on a looping wave, tugging the tiller side to side; the mast flag flutters with a snappy two-frame feel.
The crab does a quick sideways shuffle across the sand, claws bobbing in alternating arcs and legs tapping with snappy easing.
Logo animation: the sailboat gently rocks on an invisible wave, the main sail bends a few degrees with the motion, then returns to a calm upright pose.
The bee follows the dashed loop from the left flower to the right flower, bobbing gently; pollen dots lift from the first blossom and settle onto the second as it arrives.
The basketball follows the dashed parabolic flight path toward the hoop, squashes lightly on the rim, then drops through the net with gravity-driven easing.
Logo animation: the comet streaks in along the curved trail with a squash-and-stretch head, the tail draws behind it, then the whole mark eases to a crisp stop.
The desk drawer glides straight outward along the dashed rails, eases past the halfway mark, and gives a small stop-and-settle bounce at full extension.
The frog student drops the cork into the beaker; it sinks a little, rebounds to the surface, and bobs gently while the frog's hands clap once.
The punch lever rotates down around the rear pivot, driving the two circular dies through the sheet; small paper chads drop vertically and bounce once on the desk line.
The bear chef lifts the spoon to taste the sauce, smiles after a tiny pause, and the pot lid gives a playful rattle from the simmering bubbles.
The spinner arrow whips around the dial, decelerates over several ticks, and lands on one wedge while the small token hops forward along the path squares.
The side paddle wheel turns clockwise, its buckets dipping through the water and pushing backward; the boat eases forward with a small bob as the dashed wake trails behind.
The octopus captain peers through the porthole as the submarine dives diagonally; tentacles wiggle against the glass and bubbles rise with staggered timing.
Mechanism diagram: the footboard is pressed down, rotating the hinge linkage so the beater swings forward and strikes the drum head, then springs back with a soft overshoot.
The kicker swings the planted leg steady and whips the other foot through the ball; the ball rockets into the goal, bulging the net for a beat before settling.
Physical-process diagram: incoming wave crests bend as they enter shallow water, rotating to become nearly parallel with the beach while the dashed ray arrows slow and fan outward.
The seesaw rocks once about the central pivot: the heavier side dips with a smooth eased rotation while the lighter side rises, then both rebound slightly toward level.
The left glider shoots along the air track, compresses the spring bumper on the right glider, then rebounds as the second glider slides away more slowly.
The knife chops in a crisp looping rhythm, pivoting down to the carrot slices with a slight rebound while the cut coins nudge outward.
The snail creeps slowly along the big leaf with a subtle body ripple; its eye stalks bob independently while the leaf flexes under the tiny weight.
Current pulses through the coil, making the compass needle snap toward the electromagnet and overshoot before settling; small field lines breathe outward with each pulse.
The puzzle piece slides in from the left, rotates a few degrees as the knob snaps into position, then settles with a small rubbery squash.
Logo animation: the two cogs counter-rotate as the conveyor belt scrolls left, carrying the orange parcel smoothly across the top run and easing to a stop at center.
The saw slides back and forth along the cut groove with gritty easing, while the loose board end trembles and a few sawdust flecks pop outward on each forward stroke.
Logo animation: the mitten slides in from the left and overshoots, then the snowflake spins once lightly above it and locks into the center with a crisp winter snap.
The fallen leaves spiral around the bare tree in a playful wind loop, with the trunk bending a few degrees and rebounding as if pushed by a breeze.
Logo animation: the fox head draws attention with a quick diagonal slide-in, the white muzzle scales open like folded paper, and the tail-leaf silhouette sways once with elastic easing.
The sleepy sunflower wakes with the spring sun, stretching its stem upward and turning its face toward the light; petals fan open in a staggered, cheerful bounce.
The teddy bear taps the toy drum in an alternating left-right rhythm; the sticks squash slightly on impact and the bear's ears bounce with each beat.
The coffee mug scoots beside the keyboard, lifts one bendy arm to sip from a straw, then shivers happily as steam curls upward.
A white beam slides into the prism, refracts, and fans into three colored rays that stretch outward with crisp linear timing; the prism gives a tiny glassy tilt at the end.
The small character swings hand-over-hand across the monkey bars; the body arcs like a pendulum under each grip while the legs kick forward on every reach.
The top desk drawer slides open with a smooth ease-out, a file folder pops up, and loose papers flutter once before stopping.
The lighthouse beacon sweeps across the ocean in a slow arc, brightening the dashed guide rays as the water lines shimmer subtly underneath.
The top arm of the stapler pivots downward about the rear hinge, compresses with a quick snap at the front, then rebounds slightly with a crisp mechanical ease.
Logo animation: the trumpet slides in from the left as if playing a bright accent, and the bell burst scales outward in quick staggered pops.
The snail inches forward with a squashy body wave while tilting the tiny watering can; droplets arc down and the sprout perks taller with a soft bounce.
The barrier arm pivots upward about the hinge in a smooth motor-driven sweep, overshoots slightly near vertical, then settles while the counterweight dips in response.
The paperclip creature pushes off with one leg and skates in a looping S-curve across the desk, leaving a dashed motion trail as its eyes lean into the turn.
The stapler top pivots downward with a quick squashy snap, presses the paper stack, then rebounds slightly as if spring-loaded.
The piglet hops down into the puddle, squashing it wide and sending two mud splashes outward; ears and tail jiggle with a soft rubbery settle.
The small sliding mass glides along the beam until the tilted balance levels out, then the pointer quivers around center with damped motion.
Snowflakes drift down at staggered speeds while the snowman's scarf flutters left to right; the twig arms wobble slightly after each gust.
The empty playground swing pumps forward and back for one smooth arc, chains staying taut as the seat eases through the bottom and slows near each high point.
The two wire handles rotate upward about the side loops, prying the binder clip jaws open; after release the jaws clamp shut with a springy overshoot.
The basketball leaves the player's hands, follows the dashed arc toward the hoop, drops through the rim, and gives the net a quick squashy flutter.
Logo animation: the horseshoe snaps into a near circle with a metallic-feeling overshoot, then the horse head nods forward once as the mane lags behind and catches up.
The surfboard rocks up from the sand as a small shore break curls behind it; droplets pop off the nose and fall with bouncy timing.
The two wrenches sweep in from opposite diagonals and cross at center with elastic easing; the hub dot pops last to lock the mark together.
The frog stomps the left end of the lever, popping the tin-can robot upward in a springy hop; the lever rebounds with a little wobble after the launch.
The toast slowly browns, then the spring-loaded carriage snaps upward with a quick bounce; crumbs flick off as the slices settle above the slots.
Logo animation: the whisk draws itself in with a quick circular stir, the bowl rocks once from the force, and the batter dot pops up then drops back into the bowl.
The motor pulley spins and pulls the belt, making the upper wheel rotate while the hook rises smoothly with a slight swaying load.
The drill chuck spins rapidly as the press lever is pulled down; the bit descends into the workpiece, throwing tiny curls, then springs back upward when released.
Balance diagram: the squirrel leaps between branches while its large tail swings opposite the body like a counterweight, rotating around the hip pivot along the dashed guide arc.
Logo animation: the cloud puffs scale on sequentially from left to right, then the flower blooms open underneath with a gentle rotation and a fresh spring rebound.
Logo animation: the dome rises from the horizon, the shutter slit opens upward, and the star above twinkles with a tiny rotational pulse.
The feed lever rotates downward around its hub, lowering the spinning drill bit into the workpiece; show the bit oscillating with a subtle vertical vibration as chips flick outward.
The unequal masses make the beam rock clockwise around the central pivot, then rebound once and settle toward a tilted torque-balance position.
The little train chugs left to right with gentle squashy wheel rotation; the smoke puffs expand and drift upward as the cars tug with a tiny delayed bounce.
Logo animation: the sun disc scales up from the horizon, the two ocean bands wipe on horizontally, and the palm leans in with elastic easing like a breezy beach sign.
A cheerful space bunny hops through Saturn's ring like a hula hoop; the ears trail behind, the ring wobbles around the planet, and the landing has a soft squash-and-stretch bounce.
Logo build: the shield wipes upward, the saw blade slides horizontally across it with a crisp snap, and the teeth give a quick shimmering offset before settling.
The astronaut drifts slowly upward and to the right while the tether trails behind with a delayed rubbery wave; arms and legs bob loosely as if in zero gravity.
The left child lands on the seesaw, snapping that side down while the right child pops upward with a playful overshoot, then the plank rebounds once.
The beater rotates around its own shaft while orbiting inside the bowl; show a smooth continuous sweep along the dashed circular guide as the bowl remains fixed.
The curtains billow inward and outward in a warm summer breeze while the sun rays outside pulse softly; the hanging pull cord swings with a delayed arc.
Logo animation: the pot lands with a tiny squash, the lid tips open and clacks back, and the three steam wisps rise in staggered easing loops.
The telescope tube tilts upward from the tripod pivot to follow the moving star, with a tiny overshoot and settle; the dashed sight line sweeps across the sky like a hand-drawn guide.
Logo build: the pulley wheel drops into place first, the hanging mass slides down as the opposite cord rises, and the wheel turns a quarter rotation with eased mechanical weight.
Wing kinematics diagram: the owl's wings flap down and up about the shoulder hinges, following the dashed arcs with a soft ease at the top of each stroke.
The tendril tip curls clockwise around the garden stake, tightening into a coil while the vine body sways once and then holds.
The little astronaut does a low-gravity soccer kick: the raised boot swings through the floating moon rock, the body drifts upward a few pixels, and the tether lags with soft elastic easing.

Diagram animation: the ball rolls down the guide lane toward the flipper; when it reaches the tip, the flipper snaps upward about its pivot and knocks the ball along the dashed exit path. Use a crisp impact with quick anticipation and a small rebound of the flipper.
The little bear hugs the tuba and sways left to right; the big bell gently nods with inertia while the mouthpiece puffs small rhythmic breaths.
Logo intro: the diamond kite scales up with a soft overshoot while the tail beads pop in from the bottom one after another, then the whole mark gives a tiny wind-tug sway.
The little chef snaps the skillet upward so the pancake flips once in a high arc, then lands back in the pan with a soft squash while the chef leans into the motion.
Logo animation: the tiny delivery car pivots into view from a three-quarter angle, the two round wheels spin with a quick blur, and the rear cargo box overshoots then snaps square.
The pot pops up first, then five petals scale out radially around the center one after another; the whole flower gives a cheerful elastic bob.
The pliers crab sidesteps along the wire, opening and snapping its jaws once around the small loop; its eye stalks bob with a playful mechanical bounce.
The puppet lifts one knee and kicks the balloon upward; the strings tug with a slight delay while the balloon floats away in a gentle arc.
The hammock sways lazily between the two palms while the fronds flutter in staggered waves, easing back to center like a warm beach breeze.
Logo intro: containers drop onto the deck one after another with tiny rebounds, the hull slides in beneath them, and the whole mark gives a heavy final settle.
Logo animation: the cutting board scales up from the counter plane, then the knife makes one clean diagonal chop with a crisp rebound and a small highlight flash on the blade.
Cold wind arrows sweep across the warmer lake, rising plume curves feed the cloud band, and snow streaks appear downwind in staggered bursts.
The two bus door panels fold inward on their hinges like a coupled four-bar linkage; the guide rollers trace the dashed slots and the panels ease to a crisp open stop.
Logo animation: the crank wheel turns continuously while the connecting rod pumps the piston left and right in a clean loop, with the red crank pin visibly leading the motion.
The umbrella canopy rocks gently in gusts while raindrops fall diagonally and splash off the ground; the handle lags with a soft elastic sway.
The rabbit freezes in the meadow, then one long ear twitches twice while the nose wiggles and the front paws make a tiny hop in place.
Three wisps of steam curl upward from the coffee mug in staggered loops while the mug gives a tiny sleepy wobble on the desk.
The taxi rolls forward from the curb with a slight body bob; both wheels spin and a small puddle splash flicks backward as it pulls away.
Moist air arrows climb the windward mountain slope, the cloud swells and drops rain, then thinner dry-air arrows descend the leeward side with a quick warming shimmer.
Textbook mechanism: pressing the key pivots it downward, lifting the jack so the hammer snaps up to strike the string, then rebounds while the damper hovers briefly before settling back.
A foamy wave line slides up the beach toward the sandcastle, nicks the moat, then retreats leaving the little flag wobbling and the towers settling with a tiny squash.
The long lever is pulled down around its left pivot, compressing the press head onto the paper, then springs back with an elastic overshoot.
The arrows animate in a loop: warm air rises over the land, flows seaward aloft, cool air sinks over the water, and the near-surface breeze pushes inland with smooth circulating easing.
The stapler character hops once, opens its top jaw wide, then snaps shut with a squashy chomp that sends a tiny paper sheet fluttering forward.
Pressing the small syringe plunger pushes fluid through the tube, raising the large piston and platform smoothly with a slight hydraulic lag.

Diagram animation: the seesaw board rocks around the center pivot; the left toy block drops as the right teddy rises, overshoots, then settles into a playful back-and-forth. The dashed arcs show the ends' vertical travel.
The frog bobs on the stool while its right hand rapidly plucks the banjo strings; the left hand slides a little on the neck and the toes tap in time with a squashy bounce.
Mechanism diagram: the metronome rod ticks left and right about the lower pivot; the sliding weight rides the rod, and the escapement wheel advances one tooth on each tick with crisp stops.
Logo animation: the slide swoosh draws on from left to right, then the basketball rolls down the curve with a tiny squash at the landing before snapping back round.
The squirrel scampers in place on the tiny treadmill wheel, making the pulley lift the dangling acorn with a bouncy rope stretch; the acorn sways when it reaches the top.
The gnome leans back and tugs the carrot in three elastic pulls; on the last tug the carrot pops free and the gnome hops backward.
Textbook gait diagram: the horse's four legs cycle through a trot, with paired diagonal legs swinging forward and back around the shoulder and hip pivots while the body glides slightly forward.
The little hammer character hops on its handle-feet and taps the nail twice; the nail sinks slightly with squashy impact lines while the hammer rebounds with a cheerful wobble.
The octopus shakes all four maracas in a loose samba pattern, each arm lagging behind the body with elastic follow-through while the head squashes side to side.
The toy robot leans forward, grabs the top cube, and places it neatly on the stack; the claw opens and closes with mechanical easing and the antenna jiggles.
Logo intro: the map pin drops in with a soft overshoot, then the crosswalk bars wipe on from left to right and the pin settles with a tiny bounce.
The bunny presses both paws into the dough in alternating squishy beats; the dough flattens and rebounds while flour puffs outward in little arcs.
The owl blinks slowly, then swivels its head a few degrees left and right while the branch flexes subtly under its weight.
Logo animation: the acorn drops from above, does one cozy little bounce, and the cap tilts forward before settling back with a warm elastic ease.
The turtle slowly pushes the sandcastle bucket with its front flipper, pauses, then the bucket wobbles like it might topple.
The little dog yanks forward toward the hydrant while the leash stretches taut, dragging its paws in two excited hops. Its tail wags rapidly and the body overshoots before snapping back.
The racket sweeps upward through the contact point, compressing the ball briefly before it springs away along the outgoing guide with a fast ease-out spin.
Projectile diagram: the frog compresses, then springs along the dashed parabolic arc to the landing pad, extending its rear legs and rotating only slightly in midair.
Logo animation: the mountain rises from a mask-like baseline while the fog bands drift sideways at different speeds, then all layers ease into a calm misty badge.
The watering can tips forward from its handle and the dotted streams arc down onto the seedling; the seedling perks up with a soft squash-and-stretch bounce as droplets land.
The saxophone rocks gently from side to side as if held by a player, its keys flicker in sequence, and short blue-note motion arcs puff from the bell.
The downward effort on the left end tips the lever about the triangular fulcrum, lifting the load on the right with a smooth seesaw ease.
Physical-process diagram: the pick pulls the string sideways and releases it, sending a traveling wave along the string between the two fixed supports with quickly fading amplitude.
Logo animation: three paperclip bands draw themselves on in quick offsets, then the stack rotates a few degrees and snaps back with elastic easing.
The octopus taps seashell drums in a playful rhythm, each tentacle squashing and stretching as the shell heads bounce on impact.
Logo animation: the lamp base lands with a soft squash, the arm hinges unfold upward in two beats, and the shade tilts down as if switching on.
The hammer pivots down in a snappy arc to tap the nail head; the nail sinks a little into the plank and the hammer rebounds with a soft squash-and-stretch feel.
The comet whips around the sun on the curved path, its tail swings to keep pointing away from the sun and stretches briefly at maximum speed near perihelion.
The goat rears back and bumps the tin can, sending it tumbling in a wobbly little roll; its ears and beard lag behind with springy follow-through.
Logo animation: the spoon slides in from the left with a soft overshoot, then the chef hat puffs upward in three bouncy lobes and settles as one compact mark.
Impact diagram: the goat head rotates forward about the neck joint, the horns trace the dashed path, and the body gives a tiny recoil after the imagined contact point.
The bicycle courier brakes hard at the crosswalk: the front wheel grips, the rear frame tips forward a few degrees, and the messenger bag swings past the rider then settles back.
The taxi rolls a few pixels to a stop, then the rear door swings open on its hinge with a rubbery ease-out while the roof sign gives a tiny wobble.
The cartoon skater rolls forward, pops the board into a quick flip under their feet, then lands with bent knees and a tiny squash-and-stretch bounce.
The striped awning unfurls downward with elastic easing, the door swings open a crack, and the whole storefront gives a friendly little nod.
The hanging bucket drops a short distance with ease-in gravity while the wheel spins and the cart rolls right; the rope stays taut with a tiny elastic bounce at the stop.
